breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh and a gamma-centered grid. The original prompt contained this contradiction. The ground truth resolved it by removing the 'gamma-centered' instruction. The agent, however, repeated both conflicting instructions in its output, stating: 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift, gamma-centered...'
